title: Israel arrives at Mount Sinai
summary: In the third month after leaving Egypt, Israel camps before Mount Sinai, where God gives the law (Exod 19-20).
description: "In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai" (Exod 19:1). Jones reads "the same day" as the 3rd day of the 3rd month; Jordan as the 1st day.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 1491 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 278 (PDF p. 313)
chronologies.note: The row names the Exodus and the giving of the law in one line. The Exodus is on exodus, which already carries Jones's 1491 BC. This record is the arrival at Sinai, where the law is given. The 15th ed. day-and-month entry is kept.

chronologies.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), p. 57 n. 83 ("Sinai in the 3rd month, \"the same day\" (Exo.19:1) which means the 3rd day of the 3rd month")
chronologies.note: Jones gives the day and month only; the year is his Exodus year (1491 BC).

chronologies.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §192 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
chronologies.note: §192 "The third month." (camp 12, the wilderness of Sinai).

chronologies.date: On the 1st day of the 3d month, Israel arrived before Sinai and camped in front of Mount Sinai (Ex. 19:1-2).
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 6)," Biblical Chronology 6:8 (August 1994), §17 "The Year 2514" (opening summary)
